correctness.rationale: Exact core-edge/private-triangle bijection yields the arbitrary-base count. Center-state decomposition gives \(2(z+8)^r+(z+6)^r+3rz(z+8)^{r-1}\). Möbius substitution reduces nonzero roots to \(w^r+12rw+2-9r\), whose real root number and simplicity follow analytically. The finite six-base-vertex sharpness is proven by exhaustively iterating all 32768 labeled simple graphs and checking exact discriminants; an independent direct maximal-matching enumeration corroborates the seven-base-vertex witness and all 64 four-vertex bases. No finite experiment is substituted for the infinite proof.

originality.rationale: Two highly relevant primary works were inspected in full. The 2015/2016 paper counts maximal matchings of path coronas, while the 2022 result determines corona saturation numbers, not all-size counts or complex roots. published-finding corpus and literature searches for polynomial aliases, triangular coronas, subdivided stars, exact root count and dominating broader theorems found no equivalent. A 2021 adjacent paper was inspected at abstract level only, and priority cannot be proven by search alone.

value.rationale: An explicit infinite family of connected block graphs has a complete maximal-matching weight spectrum and precisely quantified nonreal zeros; this pinpoints failure of the real-rooted behavior familiar for ordinary matching generating polynomials. The earliest possible base order within all triangle coronas is seven, certified against every smaller base. This addresses a natural root-distribution question not answered by existing corona saturation-number results; it makes no unsupported log-concavity claim.
